attributes.probed_form:
All five replace only the body of `static inline f32 ClampCamVal(f32 value, f32 lo, f32 hi)`.
PROBE 1 (REGRESSED real 52 -> 72): `if (!(value < lo)) { if (!(value > hi)) { hi = value; } lo = hi; } return lo;` -- the pre-helper nested double-negated form. BOTH branch pairs fused: T88/O86, multiset 6t, and frame 72 -> 80.
PROBE 2 (REGRESSED real 52 -> 66) -- THIS IS THE REFUTATION: `if (value < lo) { return lo; } if (value > hi) { return hi; } hi = value; return hi;`, the predecessor record's two-stage merge, re-run to read its clusters rather than only its score. T88/O88, multiset 0t, and THE FOUR CLUSTERS ARE BYTE-FOR-BYTE THE BASELINE'S (`insert O[80:81]@140-144 ['fmr']`, `delete T[82:83]@148-14c ['fmr']`, and the two epilogue `addi` rows). The merge shape NEVER MOVED; the entire delta was 9 IMMEDIATE frame rows from `stwu r1,-80(r1)` against the target's `-72`. The predecessor's claim that the two-stage form 'IS the right shape here and regressed only because spelling it moved the frame' is therefore FALSE in its first half: hold the frame constant and you still have the baseline's merge.
PROBE 3 (real 55, the structural best): `if (value < lo) { return lo; } if (!(value > hi)) { hi = value; } return hi;`. THE MERGE CLOSES EXACTLY -- both `fmr` clusters vanish and the frame stays 72 -- and the guard folds: T88/O87, `target-only: +1 b +1 ble  ours-only: -1 bgt`.
PROBE 4 (NEUTRAL against probe 3, bytes identical): the same with `goto assign; goto done;` spelled out. See law_screen.
PROBE 5 (REGRESSED to real 66): `if (!(value > hi)) { hi = value; return hi; } return hi;` -- a return inside the if-body to try to buy the pair back. T88/O88, multiset 2t, the baseline's four clusters return AND the 9 frame IMMEDIATE rows return (frame 80). Assigning `hi` and then returning it from inside the arm re-creates the stack temp.

hypothesis.statement: The merge and the branch pair are a COMPENSATING PAIR in the helper-body class, and the only untried escape is to move the compensation OUT of the helper. Every form that produces the target's two-stage merge needs exactly ONE `return hi;` reached from both paths, and a single-join return makes MWCC fold the guard to one inverted conditional (87 insns). Every form that keeps the pair unfused needs an EARLY `return hi;`, and two distinct returns make MWCC write the result straight into f3 twice (the baseline's two `fmr` rows). The untried shape is a SECOND static inline helper: let the outer helper own the early `return lo;` and delegate the high clamp to `static inline f32 ClampCamValHigh(f32 value, f32 hi) { if (value > hi) { return hi; } hi = value; return hi; }`, so the pair is an INLINED CALLEE's return join (which claim.law.BF_the-unfused-branch-pair-is-an-inlined-callee-return-not-any-return.20260903.v1 says is the shape that survives the fold peephole) while the merge stays inside that callee where its single join is not the outer function's own epilogue.
